summary: Implemented climb-recording share SEO (AC-1–AC-40): standalone app/src/share payload (no PR #11 / social imports), additive recordClimb.runId, /r/{cuid} page + Node recording OG (404, s-maxage=3600) vs listing edge OG (A-12 defaults, OG_PALETTE, s-maxage=60), GET /api/share/recording/[id], robots allow /r/ with sitemap zero /r/ rows, one isBot (tiktok/bytespider/bytedance) used by middleware, ShareRun+dashboard 44×44 named X/TikTok/YouTube/Copy-link. pnpm typecheck and pnpm lint passed.
